sweep_note: Window is mixed: ROLR and BBGI amc 2026-11-13 (Friday), the other 37 bmo 2026-11-16 (Monday; the 10-Q deadline for Sept-30 non-accelerated filers rolls from Sat 11-14 to Mon 11-16, so a Nov-16 row is plausible for every domestic nano-cap but plausibility is not confirmation). 27 of 39 company-confirmed for 2026-11-16, 25 of them with the hour settled. 12 unconfirmed: the only evidence is the calendar row or an aggregator, so none was proven a phantom but none should get an Opus/high hunter ahead of a confirmed name. Neither amc-today row (ROLR, BBGI) has a company date or an 8-K by 18:10 UTC. VERI's calendar row is right only by accident: the company moved its call from Nov 12 to Nov 16 08:30 ET. Short interest is from equibles.com (FINRA settlement 2026-10-30) and is a percent of SHARES OUTSTANDING, not of float. trades_on is 'unknown' unless the baseline showed it. Baseline histories for most foreign private issuers come from 6-K text matches that pick up monthly operating updates, so they are flagged untrustworthy.
